overview_description.description:
HiGuests family started when two friends from Barcelona realized the huge amount of hassle arranging all the logistics around Airbnb. HiGuests family works HARD and PASSIONATE GLOBALY to take care of your home as it was ours. Our customers will not realize anything about the process, and we will ensure your Guests enjoy from the best stay.

HiGuests is a property management company that manages the short-term rental of properties through various portals including Airbnb, HomeAway, and Booking.com.

HiGuests has developed best in class TECHNOLOGY to manage operations, allow hosts to monitor the evolution of its property and guests to maximize their travel experience. APP for Host, Guest and our own PMS (Property Management System) is essential in our business model.

HiGuests' in-depth knowledge of the short-term rental market allows PROPERTY ONWNERS get maximum revenue potential thank to  our centralized profile mangement team (profile creation, account/revenue management/inbox management. Instant updated information throw Host App.

HiGuests offers a bespoke service to all our GUESTS to ensure they have a most enjoyable stay thanks to our local teams (check in/out, cleaning, laundry, maintenance, 24/7 guest services). App for Guest ensure 5 star review.

product.name: Short-Term Rental Property Management
product.description: Management of short-term rental properties including listing optimization, guest communication, cleaning, maintenance, and 24/7 support to maximize rental income and reduce host workload.

product.name: Dynamic Pricing and Revenue Optimization
product.description: Use of real-time data and analytics to adjust rental prices dynamically, ensuring competitive rates and maximizing host revenue.

product.name: Guest Services and Support
product.description: Provision of guest communication, check-in/check-out management, and 24/7 support to ensure smooth guest experiences.

product.name: Property Maintenance and Housekeeping
product.description: Coordination of cleaning, linen services, and maintenance tasks to keep rental properties in good condition and ready for guests.

product.name: Marketing and Listing Optimization
product.description: Creation and management of professional property listings across multiple online rental platforms to increase visibility and bookings.

product.name: Transparent Reporting and Financial Management
product.description: Provision of detailed reports and dashboards showing booking status, revenue, expenses, and performance analytics for property owners.
